claims.quote: Israel generated 16.9% of its electricity from renewables in 2025
claims.sql: SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025
SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015
SELECT (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025) - (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015)
SELECT coal_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015
SELECT coal_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025
SELECT (SELECT gas_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025) - (SELECT gas_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015)

claims.quote: indicating that gas absorbed more of coal's decline than renewables did.

claims.sql: SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Greece' AND year = 2025
SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Cyprus' AND year = 2025

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Greece' AND year = 2025) > (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025) AND (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Cyprus' AND year = 2025) > (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
